title: Did you know you can’t steal a charity? Don’t worry. Elon Musk will remind you.
brief: Elon Musk testified in his lawsuit against OpenAI this week, alleging that CEO Sam Altman betrayed the company's original nonprofit mission by converting it to a for-profit structure. The case hinges on whether OpenAI's transition violated its founding principles, with emails, texts, and tweets being used as evidence.
